purpose: Read-only research shortlist for Predome Open Forecast; not a model forecast, registered experiment, clinical validation or outcome adjudication.
source_policy: Sponsor original materials plus ClinicalTrials.gov official API; secondary search hits were discovery only and did not establish readout windows.
independence_limits: Six distinct drug assets, not six statistically independent mechanisms. Two oral estrogen receptor drugs and three Roche projects share biological and sponsor-level dependencies; cluster and sensitivity analyses must retain these dependencies.
selection_notes: No calendar day inferred from company year-only windows.
No primary-completion date used as a sponsor readout window.
No absence of ClinicalTrials.gov results treated as proof that the outcome is unpublished.
Refresh sponsor releases, conference abstracts and registry immediately before evidence lock.
Freeze study, endpoint, analysis population, success rule and cutoff; obtain protocol/SAP where public. If key success logic remains unknown, abstain or keep the item as a candidate.
Prior reported trials of the same molecule are valid earlier evidence, but cannot be relabeled as the target outcome.
Research file does not register, schedule or call a model, and contains no paid API credentials.
